verdict.rationale: BVNK documents event-triggered automation: payment rules that auto-convert incoming fiat to crypto, and webhooks that fire on account events. Neither is a recurring, time-based schedule for jobs or workflows. No evidence shows scheduled or recurring payouts, cron-like jobs, or workflow scheduling, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
